issues.title: AC3's git grep in REQ-021.md does not account for a pre-existing schema.ts prose comment naming 'waitlist_position'
issues.description: docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-021.md's AC3 lists four accounted-for match categories and states any match inside apps/bot/src/db/schema.ts is a FAIL. The literal grep also matches schema.ts:158, a REQ-011-era comment ('The computed-never-stored values (no_show, waitlist_position, seats_taken, registration_open, finished) have NO column anywhere in this file') that predates this branch entirely (confirmed via the companion git diff --stat check returning zero output for schema.ts) and whose content affirmatively documents the absence of a stored column -- the opposite of the regression AC3 exists to catch. TEST-RUNNER treated this as a pass (structurally pre-existing per core-directives.md's attribution rules, and semantically supportive of the invariant) rather than a literal FAIL, and is flagging it so REQ-021.md's AC3 wording can be tightened to add 'this pre-existing schema.ts comment' as a fifth accounted-for category, avoiding ambiguity for a future re-run.
